templates.name: Sealed Ruin Gate
templates.setup: An ancient or abandoned structure presents an intact sealed entrance.

stages.contact: The gate reacts to the submarine or crew.
stages.aftermath: The expedition must leave without trapping itself inside.

complications: The gate only opens from within.
A guardian signal activates.
The interior is under incompatible pressure.
opportunities: The chamber contains relics or research.
The gate controls a regional passage.
templates.reward: The expedition opens the site and establishes a safe exit.
templates.failure: The team is trapped, injured, or forced to abandon equipment.
templates.persistent: An opened gate permanently changes the location's available encounters.

templates.name: Abandoned Laboratory
templates.setup: A research site was evacuated too quickly to sanitize its work.

stages.crisis: Containment or automated security begins failing.
stages.aftermath: The crew must decide what knowledge is worth carrying home.

complications: The samples are still alive.
The lead scientist falsified the logs.
A corporate retrieval team is inbound.
opportunities: Medical or biological materials remain usable.
templates.reward: The crew recovers controlled research and useful supplies.
templates.failure: Containment failure consumes medical stores and harms the crew.
templates.persistent: Recovered research can unlock a formal R&D project.

templates.name: Flooded Industrial Site
templates.setup: An old mine, factory, or transport works remains partly functional under flood.

stages.crisis: Restored machinery begins moving with no one at the controls.
stages.aftermath: The crew must shut down or repurpose the site before collapse.

complications: The flood water is contaminated.
Workers were sealed inside.
The machinery connects to a station utility.
opportunities: The site can become a recurring resource node.
templates.reward: The crew recovers useful materials and stabilizes the site.
templates.failure: The site collapses or damages expedition equipment.
templates.persistent: A stabilized site may be claimed, sold, or assigned to a faction.

templates.name: Impossible Geometry
templates.setup: A ruin's interior refuses to preserve distance, direction, or sequence.

stages.crisis: The exit disappears while the structure rearranges.
stages.aftermath: The expedition must create a reliable path back to reality.

complications: A crew member remembers a different route.
The structure copies voices.
Time outside passes at another rate.
opportunities: The geometry reveals an alien transit principle.
templates.reward: The crew returns with coherent maps and extraordinary data.
templates.failure: The team loses time, readiness, and confidence in its own senses.
templates.persistent: Maps of the site remain useful only to those who participated.

templates.name: Coalition Inspection Patrol
templates.setup: An armed patrol orders the submarine to stop for identity, cargo, and mission inspection.

stages.crisis: Inspectors focus on a discrepancy or private compartment.
stages.aftermath: The crew must leave without confiscation, arrest, or a political debt.

complications: The patrol has the wrong warrant.
A crew member is already flagged.
The inspectors are hunting someone else.
opportunities: The patrol offers a legitimate contract.
templates.reward: The vessel passes inspection and may gain official information.
templates.failure: Credits, supplies, or time are lost to seizure and delay.
templates.persistent: How the crew handled inspection changes future official treatment.

templates.name: Pirate Parley
templates.setup: A pirate vessel opens communications before committing to an attack.

stages.contact: The pirates offer terms that are almost reasonable.
stages.crisis: Both sides reveal enough strength to make retreat difficult.
stages.aftermath: The crew must secure passage, information, or surrender without appearing weak.

complications: The pirate captain knows a crew member.
Their vessel is damaged.
A hidden second pirate is approaching.
opportunities: A negotiated truce creates a black-market contact.
templates.reward: The crew avoids battle and gains leverage or information.
templates.failure: The pirates take payment, supplies, or the initiative.
templates.persistent: A promise made in parley becomes enforceable campaign debt.

templates.name: Church of the Husk Pilgrims
templates.setup: A quiet vessel or group of travelers requests aid while refusing ordinary medical inspection.

stages.contact: Their language is polite and rehearsed.
stages.crisis: Evidence of deliberate husk exposure appears.
stages.aftermath: The crew must prevent infection without turning uncertainty into massacre.

complications: Some pilgrims are uninfected hostages.
A station official protects them.
They carry valuable medical data.
opportunities: Captured records expose a cult route.
templates.reward: The crew contains the threat and preserves usable intelligence.
templates.failure: Infection risk, medical loss, and political consequences follow.
templates.persistent: Surviving cultists remember the crew and may infiltrate a later station.

templates.name: Children of the Honkmother Flotilla
templates.setup: A brightly marked clown flotilla approaches with jokes, gifts, noise, and no respect for operational boundaries.

stages.crisis: A prank interferes with navigation, security, or emergency equipment.
stages.aftermath: The crew must restore safety without losing control of the social situation.

complications: One clown is hiding from another faction.
A dangerous device is mistaken for a prop.
The flotilla knows a real threat is nearby.
opportunities: The flotilla can spread a message quickly.
templates.reward: The crew extracts useful information and prevents sabotage-by-stupidity.
templates.failure: Supplies are wasted and a system is damaged by escalating pranks.
templates.persistent: Public humiliation or friendship changes future clown encounters.
